verdict.rationale: Any product with a public website and docs can publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation, so this axis applies to Lighthouse, an immigration-services platform with case software. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. None of the docs mention agent-oriented documentation; they cover only pricing, visa services and blog guides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
